methods.rationale: Matches the base FY2026 US-GAAP EPS sensitivity: H2 residual $1.90 after reported H1 EPS $1.75 under a constant-share approximation. A 50x P/E is a stress anchor, not an observed or fair multiple.

Revenue bridge uses reported H1, management Q3 guidance and an assumed Q4. The 15x EV/revenue stress reflects premium growth/margins but deliberately sits below the third-party page's dated 17.368 current EV/sales snapshot; methodological definitions can differ. Net cash includes cash only, making this method conservative if marketable investments exceed debt.

Five-year unlevered-equity-style cash-flow sensitivity uses annualized H1 OCF less capex as a rough starting point, then 15% growth to test sustained AI/enterprise demand, a 10% discount rate for execution and duration risk, and 4% terminal growth. Working-capital cyclicality, stock compensation treatment and omitted marketable investments materially limit precision.

assumptions: Three correlated conditional valuation sensitivities compared with the 2026-09-22 split-adjusted close, not independent estimates, consensus, fair-value claims or probability-weighted targets. FY2026 revenue of $12.4bn assumes H1 reported $5.7447bn, management Q3 revenue guidance of about $3.3bn, and $3.3553bn in Q4; this tests continued AI/cloud and enterprise/campus demand. Starting annual free cash flow of $5.3bn is an analyst run-rate assumption informed by H1 operating cash flow of $2.7765bn less $84.2m capex, but working-capital timing can make that extrapolation materially inaccurate. Net cash is conservatively represented by the $2.2902bn SEC cash-and-cash-equivalents figure only because total marketable securities and debt are not available in the normalized facts; therefore EV/revenue and DCF values omit potentially material net investments. Diluted shares of 1.2749bn use H1 2026 weighted-average diluted shares from company results; future dilution or repurchases can differ. The 15x EV/revenue, 15% five-year FCF growth, 10% discount rate and 4% terminal growth are explicit stress assumptions selected to test durable AI networking growth and high cash conversion against cycle normalization; they are not observed or historically normal multiples/rates.
qualification: All forward financial inputs and valuation multiples are explicit analyst/model assumptions unless a cited source states otherwise. The three methods are correlated and do not form a statistical confidence interval. Values are conditional sensitivities, not targets or guarantees.
